R7AG-bear-atv-0003.name: 3.6 km SW of Finlay River
R7AG-bear-atv-0003.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R7AG-bear-atv-0003.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (unsigned); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2007 (19 years old), 110 m NW: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
SW facing slope, 11 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Unnamed wetland 50 m SW: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

plan: Drive: from Bear Lake, about 185 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 57.11158, -125.25122, where the truck road ends (unsigned); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 7.7 km on Rs27000 by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 290 m S, climb about 8 m.

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-40, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2023-09-20, closures 2026-10-16.

Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
3 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
7 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 7A table (page 57), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). MU 7-1 is listed in Region 7A on page 2 but no row names it.

Elk winter range u-7-017 (official), 470 m NE.

plan: Drive: from Bear Lake, about 185 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 57.12394, -125.26484, pull off on unsigned (gravel road). Map links below.
